themes.name: Commercial Renewals and Retention
themes.definition: Renewals, contracts, pricing and SLA negotiation, churn risk, expansion deals.
themes.boundary_note: If a call is mainly about product adoption with renewal as an aside, use Product Adoption, Feedback and Expansion.

examples.title: Aegis / Atlas Precision - Contract Discussion
examples.quote: Your current contract runs through end of March, so we wanted to get ahead of it a bit, talk through the current structure, see if anything needs to be adjusted going into the next term.

examples.title: Aegis / Nova Retail Group - Renewal Discussion
examples.quote: So, um, I wanted to reach out specifically because your renewal is coming up at the end of next month and I just — I want to make sure we're in a good place and that you're getting value out of the platform.

examples.title: Aegis / Atlas Precision - Annual Review & Renewal
examples.quote: So Wayne, the whole purpose of today is really just — it's your annual review, renewal's coming up at the end of May, and I want to make sure we're doing right by you before we get into any of that paperwork stuff.

themes.name: Product Adoption, Feedback and Expansion
themes.definition: Previews, launches, early access, roadmap input, feature requests, adoption and compliance-readiness reviews of the product, and internal launch-readiness reviews.
themes.boundary_note: The module belongs in the product area field, not in the theme. Renewal talk that is only an aside stays here.

examples.title: Aegis / Redwood Clinical - Product Feedback Session
examples.quote: The current reporting in Comply is... it's okay, but it's pretty static.

examples.title: Aegis / Stratos Cloud - Audit Preparation
examples.quote: So the core value proposition with Comply is that it maps your environment continuously to whatever frameworks you're targeting — SOC 2, ISO 27001, we also support PCI DSS and HIPAA — and it generates audit-ready reports on demand.

examples.title: Aegis / Silverline Brands - Comply v2 Early Access Demo
examples.quote: Perfect, yeah that's — honestly that's exactly why I wanted to get you on early access for the Comply v2 demo because what you're about to see is going to be really relevant to that audit cycle.

themes.name: Incident and Outage Response
themes.definition: War rooms, root cause, remediation plans, customer impact assessment, incident communication, postmortems, reliability reviews.
themes.boundary_note: A single customer's technical fault that is not a platform incident belongs in Technical Integration and Performance Issues.

examples.title: Support Case #6147 - Summit Trust Detect Alert Delays
examples.quote: The fix is migrating your tenant to a less-loaded node cluster. I can initiate that request right now as an emergency rebalance — that goes to our infrastructure team with a priority flag.

examples.title: URGENT: Blackridge Investments - Complete Loss of Threat Visibility
examples.quote: So what I can see from our internal status is that there was a cascading failure in the event ingestion layer — it looks like a single component went down and it took the rest of the processing queue with it, engineering is working on isolating and restarting the affected nodes.

examples.title: Detect Outage - Root Cause Analysis
examples.quote: So from what I can tell in the logs, the primary ingestion node started throwing out-of-memory errors around 6:47 AM.

themes.name: Technical Integration and Performance Issues
themes.definition: Support-style troubleshooting: SSO, SAML, SCIM, LDAP, MFA failures, connectors and SIEM integration, backup windows and throughput, report defects, API errors, internal scalability concerns.
themes.boundary_note: Module-specific problems go here with the module in the product area field. A platform-wide outage is Incident and Outage Response.

examples.title: Aegis / Frostbyte AI - Product Feedback
examples.quote: The reason I wanted to have this call is really around some gaps we're hitting on the IAM side — specifically around how Aegis Identity handles role management at scale.

examples.title: Support Case #1514 - Meridian Capital Granular Restore Request
examples.quote: Granular file-level restore, like truly arbitrary path-based restore from within a snapshot, that's not currently a supported workflow in Protect.

examples.title: Support Case #3546 - Meridian Capital SCIM Provisioning Request
examples.quote: Exactly, SCIM 2.0, yeah — we want Okta to be the source of truth, so when someone is offboarded in Okta it automatically propagates through to Aegis Identity and their access is revoked.

themes.name: Onboarding and Implementation Scoping
themes.definition: Kickoffs, deployment planning, architecture scoping, setup workshops.
themes.boundary_note: Troubleshooting of an already deployed integration is Technical Integration and Performance Issues.

examples.title: Aegis / Clearwater Medical - Comply v2 Deployment Kickoff
examples.quote: Alright, I think we've got everyone on now — Natalie, Ajay, good to see you both, welcome to the Comply v2 kickoff!

examples.title: Aegis / Harborview Banking - Threat Detection Tuning
examples.quote: So, um, welcome everyone — this is our threat detection tuning session for Harborview Banking.

examples.title: Aegis / Frostbyte AI - Identity Module Setup
examples.quote: Absolutely, so — maybe just to set the stage for today, the goal is to walk through your Identity module setup, understand your current IAM landscape, and start mapping out the SSO and MFA configuration.

themes.name: Billing and Usage Disputes
themes.definition: Invoices, overages, seat counts, billing adjustments.
themes.boundary_note: Small theme (about 4 calls in the pilot); kept because it is distinct and actionable.

examples.title: Support Case #8179 - Clearwater Medical Overage Charges Dispute
examples.quote: We got our April invoice and there are overage charges totaling just over four thousand dollars that I do not understand and frankly did not expect. At all.

examples.title: Support Case #7570 - Silverline Brands Comply v2 License Upgrade
examples.quote: And basically the issue is we upgraded to Comply v2 when it launched on the seventh and we're seeing a billing discrepancy that we can't quite figure out.

examples.title: Support Case #7572 - Brightpath Commerce Invoice Discrepancy
examples.quote: So, just to frame this up — the case notes say you're seeing a discrepancy on your February invoice, is that right?

themes.name: Competitive Strategy and Win/Loss
themes.definition: Competitive intelligence, battlecards, win/loss analysis, and customer-facing calls where the customer is evaluating alternatives.
themes.boundary_note: Definition widened from the pilot's internal-only version to include customer calls about evaluating alternatives.

examples.title: Competitive Threat Assessment - Post Outage
examples.quote: Six hours of zero threat monitoring visibility is not something our customers are just going to brush off, and our competitors are absolutely going to use this against us.

examples.title: Competitive Landscape Review
examples.quote: Okay cool, so I figured we should probably carve out some time to actually go through the competitive landscape before the product review next week, because I feel like we've been kind of operating on vibes a little bit.

examples.title: Win/Loss Analysis - Q1
examples.quote: Sure. So in Q1 we had — I'm looking at my sheet here — 34 closed-lost opportunities with a total combined ACV of around 2.1 million. Of those, 22 had a named competitor as the reason or it was noted in the loss notes.

themes.name: Internal Planning and Delivery Cadence
themes.definition: Standups, sprint planning, retros, all-hands, design and roadmap syncs with no customer or incident focus.
themes.boundary_note: If a meeting is mainly an incident, use Incident and Outage Response.

examples.title: SOC 2 Audit Preparation - Internal
examples.quote: Okay so, the reason I pulled everyone together today — as you all know we've got our SOC 2 Type II audit window coming up, and I want to make sure we're not scrambling at the last minute.

examples.title: Protect Team - Quarterly Planning
examples.quote: Okay so — quarterly planning for Protect, Q2 is coming up fast, I want to make sure we actually go into it with a solid plan this time and not scrambling like we did in Q4.

examples.title: Comply v2 - Design Review
examples.quote: Alright, so the purpose of today's call is really to do a proper design review for Comply v2 before we lock the spec.

other_policy: Other / new theme only if no theme fits. More than 10% of calls in Other triggers a taxonomy revision (new version, full re-run).
tags_rule: Up to two further themes from the list per call, besides one primary theme; a tag never repeats the primary theme.

product_areas.name: Comply
product_areas.note: Compliance reporting and evidence mapping (including Comply v2).

product_areas.name: Identity
product_areas.note: Directory sync, SSO, SAML, SCIM, MFA, IAM governance.

product_areas.name: Platform/General
product_areas.note: No single product dominates, or the call is cross-product.

incident.definition: Set incident to '2026-03-detect-outage' (otherwise null) when the call's main purpose, or a major part of it, is the March 2026 Detect event-processing pipeline outage: cause, impact, remediation, customer communication or aftermath. A separate field so the outage story is visible across support, external and internal calls.
